name: batshit-mac
description: Zero Native shell for the Batshit Mac app.

scripts.doctor: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zero-native doctor --strict --manifest app.zon
scripts.doctor:chromium: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zero-native doctor --strict --manifest app.chromium.zon --web-engine chromium --cef-dir third_party/cef/macos
scripts.shell: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zig build run -Dzero-native-path=node_modules/zero-native
scripts.shell:chromium: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zig build run -Dzero-native-path=node_modules/zero-native -Dweb-engine=chromium -Dcef-auto-install=true
scripts.shell:dev: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zig build dev -Dzero-native-path=node_modules/zero-native
scripts.test: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zig build test -Dzero-native-path=node_modules/zero-native
scripts.package:mac: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zig build package -Dzero-native-path=node_modules/zero-native -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe
scripts.package:mac:chromium: npm run ensure:zig && npm run patch:zero-native && PATH="$PWD/.zig/zig-aarch64-macos-0.16.0:$PATH" zig build package -Dzero-native-path=node_modules/zero-native -Dweb-engine=chromium -Dcef-auto-install=true -Doptimize=ReleaseSafe
